attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file South Carolina state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in SC (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "SC" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets SC economic nexus threshold ($100K or 200 transactions)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "SC" streq } over if

action_details.action_dsl: add "SC filing required due to physical presence. Reference: SC Code 12-6-2320" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "SC filing required due to physical presence. Reference: SC Code 12-6-2320" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_dsl: add "SC filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100K OR 200 transactions. Reference: SC Code 12-36-2691" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "SC filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100K OR 200 transactions. Reference: SC Code 12-36-2691" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; No SC nexus - no filing requirement
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No SC nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No SC nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate SC state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate SC state additions and subtractions; Calculate SC-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "SC income adjustments calculated. Reference: SC Code 12-6-1130 (additions), 12-6-1140 (subtractions)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "SC income adjustments calculated. Reference: SC Code 12-6-1130 (additions), 12-6-1140 (subtractions)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments; No SC nexus - no adjustments calculated
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "No SC nexus - no adjustments calculated." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No SC nexus - no adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate SC state corporate income tax. Applies SC 5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. Also includes SC annual license fee.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate SC tax at 5% flat rate; SC income tax at 5% plus license fee
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate; set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_tax + apportionment.license_fee_minimum; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "SC tax calculated at 5% flat rate plus license fee ($15 minimum). Reference: SC Code 12-6-530, 12-20-50" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax apportionment.license_fee_minimum f+ cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "SC tax calculated at 5% flat rate plus license fee ($15 minimum). Reference: SC Code 12-6-530, 12-20-50" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No SC nexus - no tax liability; No SC nexus - no tax
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No SC nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No SC nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income - license fee only; No SC taxable income but license fee applies
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.license_fee_minimum; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "No SC taxable income - license fee only ($15 minimum). NOL carryforward 15 years. Reference: SC Code 12-6-1500, 12-20-50" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.license_fee_minimum cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No SC taxable income - license fee only ($15 minimum). NOL carryforward 15 years. Reference: SC Code 12-6-1500, 12-20-50" job.audit_trail swap addto
